brief.headline: Push for a ₹14.26 L/year saving by matching the ₹66.48/KG price we already pay Sayaji Industries

priceAsk.summary: Ask them to match ₹66.48/KG — the price Sayaji Industries gives us for the same Dextrose
priceAsk.target: ₹66.48/KG (down from our current ₹75.51/KG average with Universal)
priceAsk.basis: We're paying them 13.6% more than Sayaji for identical material. The market asking price for Anhydrous Dextrose IP sits at ₹60–81/kg (typical ₹66–73/kg), so ₹66.48/KG is right in the fair band and is already proven in our own supply chain.

paymentTermAsk.summary: Keep the current 30 Days After Receipt terms — no reason to tighten

brief.financialLeverage: Universal publishes no financial statements, so we can't see their revenue, profit or how tight their cash is. Our ₹59.65 L annual spend is meaningful but not huge. Without their numbers we lean on two facts: we have a working alternate in Sayaji at ₹66.48/KG, and the open market shows plenty of other dextrose makers (Tirupati Starch, Gulshan Polyols, Sanstar, plus the Indian arms of Roquette and Ingredion). That gives us room to push firmly on price — if they won't move to ₹66.48/KG, we can shift volume or qualify a second source.

evidence.point: We pay Universal ₹75.51/KG on average, while Sayaji gives us ₹66.48/KG for the same Dextrose
Our total spend with Universal is modest
The market asking price for Anhydrous Dextrose IP spans ₹60–81/kg, with a typical range of ₹66–73/kg — verdict: MARKET-FAIR (slightly favourable)
India's export unit value for Dextrose sits much lower, showing global competitiveness
We already pay 30 Days After Receipt — reasonable terms, no need to change

alternates.name: Sayaji Industries Limited (current supplier)
alternates.why: Already supplying us at ₹66.48/KG — proven quality and the benchmark price for this negotiation

alternates.name: Tirupati Starch & Chemicals Ltd
alternates.why: A lead to qualify (verify before RFQ): listed Indore wet-miller making Dextrose ANHYDROUS at IV-fluid grade — exact form match; confirm IP monograph CoA before switching

alternates.name: Gulshan Polyols Ltd
alternates.why: A lead to qualify (verify before RFQ): listed starch & polyol maker, established in dextrose/sorbitol — a drop-in alternate to Gujarat Ambuja/Sayaji

risks: Universal's financials aren't public, so we can't gauge their stability or how desperate they might be — watch for any signs of supply trouble and keep Sayaji volume steady as insurance
If we push too hard and they walk, we'll need time to qualify Tirupati or Gulshan — start those audits now so we have real options in three months
The ₹66.48/KG Sayaji price is our sole hard benchmark; if Sayaji's price moves up, our negotiating floor weakens — lock in a Sayaji rate or get a second quote before the meeting
brief.suggestedOpeningLine: We value the relationship, but we're paying you ₹75.51/KG when Sayaji gives us ₹66.48/KG for the same Dextrose — let's talk about how we close that 13.6% gap.
